mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", ability_id AS "abilityId", param_key AS "paramKey", numeric_value AS "numericValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_parameters WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND ability_id = #{abilityId} AND param_key = #{paramKey}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.ability_parameters (game_id, ability_id, param_key, numeric_value, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{abilityId}, #{paramKey}, #{numericValue}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, ability_id, param_key) DO UPDATE SET numeric_value = EXCLUDED.numeric_value, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", ability_id AS "abilityId", param_key AS "paramKey", numeric_value AS "numericValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_parameters WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, ability_id, param_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.ability_parameters_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, ability_id, param_key, numeric_value ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, ability_id, param_key, numeric_value FROM public.ability_parameters WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, ability_id, param_key, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, numeric_value = EXCLUDED.numeric_value
